entries.basis: Complete current-source read of the four core schemas, statistics sheets and 13 shipped views plus catalog, navigation and row-window consumers. No production defect confirmed. A missing cross-schema referential-integrity invariant is now a retained test.

Complete current-source review with QueryEngine and CellFormatter consumers confirmed a display-provenance defect: aggregate legacy/imported flags were computed but ignored by formatting. The bounded correction preserves numeric aggregation and warning precedence while exposing imported-ranking provenance.

Complete current-source review of the isolated device self-test and its DatasetStore, QueryEngine, CellFormatter and RunLogWriter interactions found no production defect. A retained independent two-run regression closes the prior one-sided assertion gap by proving finished internal item identity is visible while the same unfinished-run field remains hidden.

Complete current-source review of Home card construction, rules scope, finished-run filtering, records, recent runs, characters, gear, enemies and difficulty presentation found no production defect. A retained independent three-run regression closes the missing finished-run scope assertion.

Complete current-source review of line encoding/decoding, compatibility behavior and Query, Filter, Aggregate and SavedViews consumers found no production defect. A retained full-field regression closes missing coverage for escaped delimiters, empty-text cardinality, aggregate metadata/extreme values and stable repeated encoding.

Complete current-source review of the immutable question schema, with-methods, complexity and Questions/QueryEngine consumers found no independent defect. Its stale internal selections exposed a transition defect in the Questions/WndUimsdAsk boundary.

Complete current-source review confirmed that disabling Hidden details left previously selected internal measure, group and filter parts in the displayed question while query construction rejected them. One sanitizer now removes only internal parts and the answer path uses one sanitized question for display and execution.

Complete current-source review of run, item, enemy, death and legacy mapping confirmed one bounded defect: lenient Calendar parsing normalized impossible Gregorian dates into false run.startMillis values. The correction validates month/day bounds, retains valid leap days and leaves raw history untouched.

Complete current-source review reproduced a fail-open boundary in CRC-valid derived row caches: reserved log flags, ruleset tags, merge-key markers, row flags and cell kinds could be accepted as ordinary defaults, including silently converting unknown kind 3 into missing data. Strict metadata validation now rejects those derived caches so DatasetStore rebuilds only from unchanged source logs.

retained_test.coverage: one exact valid fixture and six reserved-value fail-closed fixtures

entries.basis: Complete current-source review of raw-log discovery, source-bound cache reuse/rebuild, optional cache writes, recorded/imported assembly, run completion and ruleset resolution, inherited run facts and legacy duplicate matching found no production defect. An initial negative-segment fixture was invalid and retained as a failed attempt; the corrected valid 0/Integer.MAX_VALUE same-time boundary passes through the public DatasetStore load path.

Complete current-source review of scope/privacy, filter validation and evaluation, coverage, stable row/group sorting, grouping and aggregate semantics found no new production defect. Two initial numeric-IN attempts were invalid because NUM intentionally does not offer IN; the unreachable evaluator edit was fully reverted. Retained deterministic 10,000-row stress verifies legitimate filter/sort/coverage/purity and grouped aggregate behavior against independent models.

Complete current-source review of render dispatch, UTC/safe filenames, file-picker callbacks and asynchronous output completion, exact share-size gating, provider exception handling and player-visible outcomes found no production defect. Retained tests now cover the previously untested filename/share/picker boundaries.

Complete current-source review of lifetime, current-view, group, group comparison, run, run comparison and seed-floor report construction; hidden-data gating, provenance and omission accounting found no production defect. Valid SeedFloors assembly keeps recorded floors out of canonical item/mob rows. Retained grouped stress closes the remaining row-cap branch.

Complete review of Markdown, plain-text, self-contained HTML and CSV rendering, marks/legend/provenance, row omission accounting, escaping, UTC footer and determinism. Confirmed and fixed leading-whitespace CSV formula exposure without changing ordinary signed numbers.
entries.confirmed_defect: CSV formula neutralization inspected only character zero; spreadsheet whitespace trimming could expose tab/space-prefixed =,+,-,@ input.

entries.basis: Complete current-source review of model construction, nullable display normalization, heading bounds, block/provenance inspection, first-table selection and state tracking found no production defect. Dedicated retained tests now cover the previously indirect boundary contracts.

Complete current-source review of ungrouped/grouped layout, coverage labels, paging clamps, sort metadata, cell/detail alignment and width estimates found no production defect. Dedicated retained tests now cover direct boundary contracts that were previously exercised only indirectly.

Complete current-source review of synchronized access, detached list snapshots, replacement-by-ID semantics, insertion order and view-to-dataset resolution found no production defect. Existing UimsdModelTest concurrency coverage was retained; dedicated tests now cover the remaining direct contracts.

Complete current-source review against every current mob source that installs Property.BOSS found no production defect. Retained coverage now ties all sixteen supported top-level/nested boss classes to their real Class names and rejects helpers/lookalikes.

Complete current-source review of per-type picker sets, ordering, value arity and internal drilldown predicates found no production defect. Direct retained tests now lock every public operator set and keep internal predicates outside ordinary filters.

Complete current-source review of offline schema-only matching, public/internal visibility, normalization, deterministic catalog/column order, the 48-hit ceiling and Question-builder navigation found no production defect. Retained tests now lock the result prefix and stale-question reset boundaries.

Complete current-source review reproduced binary-double drift in fixed-point filter parsing, including 1.005 hundredths rounding down and the exact Long.MAX_VALUE hundredths boundary being rejected. Exact BigDecimal scaling now preserves the typed value and existing Math.round tie direction while rejecting out-of-long results.

Complete current-source review of immutable aggregate descriptions, constructor normalization, factories, conditional/distinct refinements, stable generated ids, label-neutral equality and hash behavior plus QueryCodec, GroupBy, QueryEngine and report consumers found no production defect. Dedicated retained tests now lock the previously indirect value-object boundary contracts.

Complete current-source review of stable display-provenance identifiers, immutable text/state/small-sample fields, constructor defaults and table, Home, detail and report consumers found no production defect. A retained direct contract now prevents state-id drift and loss of normal/small-sample semantics.

Complete current-source review of page-count arithmetic, negative/oversized page clamps, empty/exact/partial pages and WndUimsdReport comparison navigation found no production defect. Existing retained tests already cover reachability and Integer.MAX_VALUE without overflow.

Complete current-source review with the background GrudgeHooks consumer confirmed that a finished Cleric row with recorded class but missing outcome was counted as a real run, contradicting the explicit no-estimation contract. The bounded guard now requires both fields before counting.

Complete current-source review of responsive window width, visible list height, wrapped action rows, stacked endpoints and half-open row lookup found no production defect. Retained boundary coverage now locks empty stacks, exact row transitions and exclusion of the final endpoint.
